facts.statement: Hexinlusaurus is a basal ornithischian dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic of China.
facts.quote: Hexinlusaurus is a genus of basal ornithischian dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic (Bajocian stage) Lower Shaximiao Formation of what is now China.

facts.statement: Hexinlusaurus was a small, fast-moving herbivore.
facts.quote: Hexinlusaurus was a small, fleet-footed herbivore.

facts.statement: The genus name honors Professor He Xin-Lu of Chengdu University of Technology, who first named the specimen.
facts.quote: The etymology of the genus name honors Professor He Xin-Lu (from the Chengdu University of Technology) who originally named the specimen as Y. multidens + the Greek sauros (=lizard).

facts.statement: Hexinlusaurus is distinguished from other basal ornithischians by a marked concavity extending over the lateral surface of the postorbital bone.
facts.quote: A small ornithischian dinosaur distinguished from all other basal ornithischians by a single autapomorphy, the presence of a marked concavity that extends over the lateral surface of the postorbital.

facts.statement: Hexinlusaurus lived approximately 165 to 161 million years ago, from the Bathonian to Callovian stages, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente entre 165 a 161 millones de años, desde el Bathoniense al Calloviense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Hexinlusaurus is considered a link between the Fabrosauridae and Hypsilophodontidae families.
facts.quote: Es considerado un nexo entre los fabrosáuridos y los hipsilofodóntidos.

facts.statement: The classification of Hexinlusaurus has varied, with it being assigned to Hypsilophodontidae by Alifanov and Saveliev in 2014 and to Neornithischia by Han et al. in 2012 and Madzia et al. in 2018.
facts.quote: Fue asignado a Ornithischia por Barrett et al. en 2005 y a Neornithischia por Butler et al. en 2007, 2008 y Butler y Sullivan en 2009, a Hypsilophodontidae por Alifanov y Saveliev en 2014 y a Neornithischia por Han et al. en 2012 y Madzia et al. en 2018.

facts.statement: The time range for Hexinlusaurus is estimated from 170.9 to 154.8 million years ago, spanning the Bajocian to Oxfordian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Bajocian to Oxfordian (170.9 to 154.8 million years ago)
